UPSSSC Pharmacist Ayurvedic Exam City Details 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the exam city details for the Post of Ayurvedic Pharmacists posts. This recruitment was released for 1002 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Pharmacist Ayurvedic Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 12 February 2024, to 03 March 2024. The examination is going to conducted on 20 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSSSC Ayurvedic Pharmacists Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 12 February 2024
  • Last Date : 03 March 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 March 2024
  • Correction Last Date : 11 March 2024
  • Eligibility Result : 28 July 2026
  • Mains Exam Fees Payment : 25 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 20 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 11 September 2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
